data.name: Jaikrish
data.gender_notes: Jaikrish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jai: victory, Krish: God. Jaikrish represents the victory of God over evil. The name Jaikrish carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaikrish usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that invokes the blessings of Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Jaikrish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaikrish total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

vedic_reference.note: Jaikrish is a compound name derived from 'Vijay' meaning victory and 'Krishna' meaning black or dark. It is not a Vedic name.

historical_references.reference: Jaikrishna Suri was a Hindu Jain merchant from Gujarat who migrated to Burma in the late 18th century. He was a prominent figure in Burmese trade and diplomacy during the Konbaung Dynasty (1752-1885). After his death, he was venerated as a deity in Burmese Buddhism under the name 'Jaikrishna Thootho Mingyi'.
historical_references.context: Burmese trade and diplomacy during the Konbaung Dynasty

historical_references.reference: Jaishankar Bharat was a 16th-century Hindu warrior-saint from South India. He is popularly known as 'Jaishankar Ashtami' or 'Jaishankar Baba'. He was a devotee of Lord Shiva and is believed to have performed numerous miracles during his lifetime. His followers believe that he attained liberation while meditating on the banks of the River Krishna.
historical_references.context: Hindu warrior-saint and devotee of Lord Shiva
